description: Record that the student already has some of a course's files, without downloading them, so get_unsaved_course_files stops listing them. This writes only the server's own record (a small file in the server's settings folder); it never writes, moves or deletes a course file. Use it only when the student says they already have those files. Ask the student which ones before marking; ask the student before marking everything (allUnsaved), and never mark files as saved to make a list shorter or because a download is slow. Give topics: a list of { topicId, path? } with ids from get_unsaved_course_files; add the absolute path of the student's copy when known (it must exist now, must not be a network path starting with \\ or //, and later a missing file is reported like any saved file). A topic marked without a path counts as saved but the server never checks a file for it (markedSavedCount, markedTopicIds). allUnsaved: true marks every topic that is unsaved right now, and is refused if the saved records or the course's table of contents could not be read in full. unmarkTopicIds forgets the record for topics (including a download's record, reported per topic) and never deletes a file. Name exactly one of topics, allUnsaved or unmarkTopicIds. Each item is checked against the course's current file topics and refused with a reason if it is not one, or if its path is bad; the others still go through. If the answer says marking failed, nothing was recorded: tell the student, do not pretend it worked.

allUnsaved.description: true marks every topic that is unsaved right now. Only after the student has said they already have all of them; never a default. Refused when the saved records could not be read.

courseId.description: Course ID the topics belong to.

topics.description: Topics the student already has. Name exactly one of topics, allUnsaved or unmarkTopicIds.

path.description: Absolute path of the student's own copy, when known. It must exist now. Omit it when the student has the file but you do not know where.

unmarkTopicIds.description: Topic IDs to forget the record for (undo). Never deletes a file.
